title: A small change over years
hook: Two stated cases: explore the duration of a persistent annual saving.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the duration of a persistent annual saving affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the duration of a persistent annual saving in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy switch saves 2 per year for 5 years and costs 0 now. Ignoring discounting, what is its net saving?
